full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic close-up shows a face staring directly at the viewer over a strip of dark fabric lifted by both hands. Nearly black shadow fills the upper corners and lower center, leaving the eyes and fingers as the principal light forms. The face occupies almost the entire frame. Dark hair falls across the top edge and partly merges with the surrounding background, while a soft highlight runs down the forehead and bridge of the nose. Both eyes are wide and sharply legible, with pale reflections near the pupils and deep shadows beneath the brows. The left side of the face is considerably darker than the right, giving the close image a strong asymmetrical value structure. A black cloth crosses the nose and covers the mouth and lower face. On either side, pale hands pinch its upper edge; the left hand enters from the lower left with bent fingers, and the right hand curves up from the lower right. Their overlapping knuckles and fingernails remain visible in selective light. The cloth itself is almost featureless, so its straight dark band divides the luminous gaze from the busy hand shapes below. Soft photographic grain covers the midtones, and transitions from illuminated skin into black shadow are gradual rather than outlined. The viewpoint is frontal and very close, with no setting, furniture, or readable text. Light appears to arrive from the front right and slightly above, brightening the right eye, nose ridge, and fingertips while leaving the opposite side subdued. The overall composition is tense and intimate, using the narrow band of visible eyes and hands to carry emotion through deep monochrome contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影特写描绘一张脸从双手提起的深色布条上方直视观者。近乎黑色的阴影占据上方两角与下方中央，让眼睛和手指成为主要浅色形体。脸几乎填满整个画面。深色头发垂在上边缘，并部分融入周围背景，一道柔和亮部沿额头和鼻梁向下。双眼睁大而清晰可见，瞳孔附近有浅色反光，眉毛下方沉着深影。脸的左侧明显比右侧更暗，为贴近的影像建立强烈不对称明度结构。一条黑布横过鼻部，遮住嘴与下半张脸。两侧的浅色手握住它的上边缘；左手从左下伸入，手指弯曲，右手从右下向上卷起。相互重叠的指节和指甲在选择性的光线中仍可见。布面本身几乎没有细节，因此平直的深色带将发亮的目光与下方繁忙手形分开。柔和摄影颗粒覆盖中间调，受光皮肤向黑影过渡时逐渐衰减，而不是靠轮廓线分割。视点正面且极近，没有可见场景、家具或可读文字。光似乎从右前方略高处照来，点亮右眼、鼻梁和指尖，让对侧保持低调。整体构图紧张而亲密，借狭窄区域内的眼睛与双手，通过深沉单色对比传达情绪。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photographic treatment compresses a close view into broad black fields and a few sharply illuminated details. Dense shadows erase most background information, while softly graded silver midtones model selected rounded forms. Tiny catchlights and narrow pale edges hold the focal point; neighboring boundaries dissolve gradually into grainy darkness. A strong horizontal dark division interrupts more organic shapes and makes the composition feel taut. Light is directional yet soft, producing asymmetrical emphasis without hard outlines or glossy surfaces. Fine film-like grain gives the grayscale a tactile, slightly weathered finish. The overall effect is intimate and psychologically charged, with carefully withheld visual information allowing contrast and gaze-like direction to dominate.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白摄影处理把贴近视点压缩成宽阔黑色区域与少数清晰受光细节。浓重阴影抹去大部分背景信息，柔和渐变的银灰中间调塑造选定的圆润形体。细小眼神光和狭窄浅色边缘守住焦点，相邻边界逐渐消融于带颗粒的黑暗。一道强烈水平深色分割打断较有机的形状，使构图绷紧。光线有方向却柔和，制造不对称强调，而无硬轮廓或光滑亮面。细密胶片式颗粒赋予灰阶可触、略风化的表面。整体效果亲密并带心理张力，有意保留未显现的信息，使对比和视线方向占据主导。
theme_en: A face peers over dark fabric held by both hands
theme_zh: 一张面孔从双手拉起的深色布料上方凝视
name: Eikoh Hosoe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
